title: Psychological Science Accelerator: distributed-lab network for large-scale psychological evidence
summary: Promotes the Psychological Science Accelerator as distributed-lab infrastructure rather than a single replication result. It is relevant because large, diverse, coordinated samples are the machinery behind boundary-condition tests.

type_payload.query_value: A rail for converting fragile single-lab claims into multi-lab tests and broader generalizability maps.

handling_notes: Avoid turning replication into researcher humiliation or field dismissal.
Preserve the difference between failed, narrowed, inconclusive, and robust effects.
Do not promote clinical, educational, or policy implications beyond the source-backed record scope.

next_actions: Create child records for each included original effect where source permanence and author-response materials justify it.
